verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Unit lets users define event-triggered rules that run actions automatically. A 'Webhook Events' page title points to outbound event notifications, which are a developer building block for building such automation, not a rules engine. 'Configurable controls' on cards and 'flows to automate lending and repayments' are adjacent features that do not describe user-defined event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
